worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes; 'auto' sets it equal to the number of CPU cores.

worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections that each worker process can handle.

access_log_path.description: Path to the access log file.

error_log_path.description: Path to the error log file.

keepalive_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) that the server keeps connections open for keepalive reuse. Reduce for high-churn workloads.

keepalive_requests.description: Maximum number of requests per keepalive connection before it is closed. Higher values reduce connection churn.

upstreams.description: List of upstream groups for load balancing. Each defines a group of backend servers with optional keepalive tuning.

name.description: Name of the upstream group (used in proxy_pass).

keepalive_connections.description: Number of idle keepalive connections to hold per worker for this upstream group.

servers.description: List of backend servers in this upstream group.

address.description: IP address or hostname of the backend server.

port.description: Port on which the backend server listens.

backup.description: If true, this server is a backup and only used when all primary servers are down.

down.description: If true, this server is permanently marked as unavailable.

servers.description: List of server blocks (virtual hosts) to define.

listen.description: Listen address and port. Can include IPv6 (e.g., '[::]:80'), SSL (e.g., '443 ssl').

ssl.description: Whether to enable TLS for this server.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if SSL enabled).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if SSL enabled).

static_root.description: Document root for static files; leave empty to disable static serving.

proxy_pass.description: Upstream group name to proxy requests to (e.g., 'backend'); leave empty to disable proxy.

proxy_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for connecting to the upstream server.

proxy_read_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for reading response from the upstream server.
